about: Vasylkiv: an old town on the Stuhna and a private sector

Vasylkiv, on the Stuhna river, is one of the oldest towns in the Kyiv region. Housing here is mainly private houses of different ages and small apartment blocks, with few new complexes, so most requests are about renovating and rebuilding a house or building a new one on a family plot.

Plots in Vasylkiv and nearby villages are usually larger than closer to Kyiv, with room for a garage, outbuildings and a garden. We plan all of this in the site plan from the start, so the house does not get lost on the plot.

For Vasylkiv houses we often do the interior together with the architecture: a simple volume, a warm interior with wood, a kitchen-living room opening onto the garden. For smaller budgets the planning package from $6 per m² works well. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate houses and apartments: new roof and services, insulation, levelled walls, finishing; if you only need the home prepared, we do [rough renovation](/en/rough-renovation). On large plots [timber-frame](/en/timber-frame-house) and [modular houses](/en/modular-house) work well, as do classic aerated-block ones.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
